If this disease spreads in someone's town, and he, living in that area, patiently stays in his area believing, ‘Nothing will reach him except what Allah has written (and decided) for him’, and hoping for reward, (and then, by the decree of Allah, he is struck by the plague and dies) he will receive a reward equal to that of a shaheed (one who gave his life in the path of Allah),” said the Prophet ﷺ. His pure wife Hazrat Aishah (RA) narrates this

blocks.text:
Explanation: Ta'un is a deadly plague; a kind of sore appears in areas such as the thigh, the armpit or the neck. It causes severe distress, and most people die on the second or third day after this disease comes. Ta'un is also said of every plague. The ruling of the Deen is that no one should go out of an area where a plague has broken out. That is why the hadith says to stay in that town, hoping for reward.
(Takmilah Fath al-Mulhim, Fath al-Bari)

blocks.arabic_text: عَنْ أَنَسٍ ﵁ قَالَ: خَدَمْتُ رَسُولَ اللهِ ﷺ وَأَنَا ابْنُ ثَمَانِ سِنِينَ خَدَمْتُهُ عَشْرَ سِنِينَ فَمَا لَامَنِي عَلَي شَيْءٍ قَطُّ أُتِيَ فِيهِ عَلَي يَدَيَّ فَإِنْ لَامَنِي لَائِمٌ مِنْ أَهْلِهِ قَالَ: دَعُوهُ فَإِنَّهُ لَوْ قُضِيَ شَيْءٌ كَانَ.
